title: WATCH: BTS members explore Taiwan night market ahead of 'Arirang' concert

blocks.text: BTS members Jin, J-Hope, V and Jungkook enjoyed a leisurely stroll around Kaohsiung, Taiwan before staging their “Arirang” concert on Thursday, Nov. 19. In the clips shared on TikTok by several fans who saw the K-pop stars, the group members—who were accompanied by their security personnel—were visibly delighted as they explored the stores at Liouhe Night Market, trying out food and games. Although they did not stop to interact with fans, the members acknowledged them with greetings from a distance.
